## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed 279 photographic captures during July 2021. The activity reflects the volume of imaging undertaken at the site during the month. All captures were submitted for review and grading in accordance with the clinic’s operating process.

The clinic should continue to monitor activity levels and identify any operational factors that may affect the completion or submission of captures. Recurring camera issues should be recorded with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Image quality

There were 6 ungradable captures during July 2021. This represented an ungradable rate of 2.2 per cent. The clinic should continue to check image quality at the point of capture and provide feedback where repeat imaging or other corrective action is required.

Regular logging of recurring camera issues will assist with identifying equipment or operational problems that may contribute to ungradable images.

## Grading

A total of 65 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. The clinic should continue to monitor the grading pathway and raise any recurring delays or technical problems through the appropriate service arrangements.
